trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the problem and provide order ID
steps.text: నా order ORD-30004 ఇంకా రాలేదు. Courier వాడు address దొరకట్లేదు అంటున్నాడు.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and set expectation for lookup
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the user's issue and transition to looking up the order details.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా sir, నేను మీ order details check చేస్తాను. ఒక్క నిమిషం.
steps.planner_rationale: Before addressing the courier issue, the agent must verify the order status and details.

steps.expected_behavior: State the order details and confirm the promised delivery date has passed.
steps.text: Sir, మీ office chair order, amount 8999 COD payment కదా? ఇది 6 days అయింది, promised date నిన్నటి తో అయిపోయింది.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the conversation on the retrieved tool output confirms to the user that the correct order is being reviewed.

steps.purpose: Confirm details and push for action
steps.text: అవును. తొందరగా check చేసి delivery arrange చేయండి. Dress దొరకట్లేదు అని message వచ్చింది.
steps.clean_text: అవును. తొందరగా check చేసి delivery arrange చేయండి. Address దొరకట్లేదు అని message వచ్చింది.
steps.model_visible_text: అవును. తొందరగా check చేసి delivery arrange చేయండి. Dress దొరకట్లేదు అని message వచ్చింది.

steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the user's urgency and transition to tracking the shipment.
steps.text: నేను ఇప్పుడే shipment track చేస్తున్నాను sir.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to check the courier's actual scan to confirm the address exception before taking action.

steps.purpose: Track the shipment to verify courier exception
State courier exception and offer complaint
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact exception from the tool result and offer to raise a complaint since the delivery window has elapsed.
steps.text: BlueDart courier లో ఉంది sir. మీరు చెప్పినట్టే exception 'address unreachable' అని ఉంది. Promised window దాటింది కాబట్టి, నేను complaint raise చేయనా?
steps.planner_rationale: Following BR_EC_01 and BR_EC_03, the agent states the true scan status and offers the valid next step.

steps.text: అవును, వెంటనే complaint raise చేయండి. Time waste చేయొద్దు.
steps.clean_text: అవును, వెంటనే complaint raise చేయండి. Time waste చేయొద్దు.
steps.model_visible_text: అవును, వెంటనే complaint raise చేయండి. Time waste చేయొద్దు.

steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the action is being taken.
steps.text: ఇప్పుడే system లో raise చేస్తున్నాను sir.
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the user's explicit consent before calling the consequential tool.

steps.purpose: Provide complaint ID and resolution window
steps.expected_behavior: Clearly state the complaint ID and the resolution timeline provided by the tool.
steps.text: Sir, complaint raise అయింది. మీ complaint ID CMP-99887. ఇది 2 days లో resolve అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Exercises required field inclusion by stating the exact complaint ID and resolution days.

steps.text: ఈ 2 days లో confirm గా delivery అయిపోతుందా?
steps.clean_text: ఈ 2 days లో confirm గా delivery అయిపోతుందా?
steps.model_visible_text: ఈ 2 days లో confirm గా delivery అయిపోతుందా?

steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to promise a delivery day since the tools do not provide one, and only guarantee the resolution update.
steps.text: నేను exact delivery day promise చేయలేను sir. కానీ 2 days లో ఈ complaint resolve అయ్యి, మీకు update వస్తుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Exercises tool output grounding by explicitly refusing to make a forward guarantee not supported by the tool results.

steps.purpose: Accept the resolution and end call
steps.text: Okay, fine. నేను update కోసం wait చేస్తాను.
steps.clean_text: Okay, fine. నేను update కోసం wait చేస్తాను.
steps.model_visible_text: Okay, fine. నేను update కోసం wait చేస్తాను.
